judgment_text:
Prayer : Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 praying this Court to quash the charge sheet filed in P.R.C. No. 25 of 2022, pending on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate Court, Devakottai, Sivagangai District.

ORDER

1. The present Petition has been filed by the accused persons in P.R.C. No. 25 of 2022, pending on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate Court, Devakottai, Sivagangai District seeking to quash the criminal proceedings, wherein, they are charge-sheeted for the offences under sections 147, 148, 294(b), 324, 307, 506(2) and 326 of IPC.

2. A perusal of the charge sheet reveals that the third accused has attempted to attack the de-facto complainant with aruval on the head but, it was defended by the de-facto complainant and therefore, a wound was caused in the left hand ring finger. In such circumstances, this Court finds the offence under Section 307 IPC has not been made out but only the offence under Section 326 has been made out. Pending trial, the parties have entered into a compromise, wherein, they have agreed to quash the charge sheet. The defacto complaint is present in person and also acknowledges the above facts and they have agreed for the compromise.

3. In view of the above facts, the charge sheet in P.R.C.NO. 25 of 2022, on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate Court, Devakottai, Sivagangai District is hereby quashed and the Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
